title: Yo - etz | AI Interview
subtitle: // 004 - INTERNAL PROJECT
description:
The AI-Assisted Initial Interview System is a structured digital pre-interview platform designed to support and enhance the admissions process of the Polytechnic University of the Philippines (QC and Caloocan campuses).

The system standardizes how applicant interviews are conducted by providing a controlled environment for structured and semi-structured questioning, ensuring consistency, fairness, and documentation across all academic programs.

Applicants complete an AI-guided video interview, where their responses are recorded, transcribed, and summarized into a structured report. These reports are then made accessible to faculty members to support the final face-to-face evaluation.

This platform does not replace faculty decision-making. Instead, it serves as a support tool that improves transparency, reduces bias from memory-based evaluations, and ensures that all applicants are assessed using a consistent baseline.
